newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine currency exchange on line in Oct-official.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine currency exchange on line in Oct-official.

text.p: The Ukraine Interbank Currency Exchange plans to go on line with secondary market trading in October, its press secretary said on Tuesday.
Plans include starting Treasury bill trading, which takes place four times weekly, via the central bank's electronic mail.
The official said the "Contract" trade-clearing system would begin working once a week, with the ultimate aim of operating five days a week.
It would enable bank traders from all over Ukraine to conduct transactions. --Natalya Zinets, Kiev Newsroom +380 44 229 2264
